views: view1: แปลนคานหลังคาเหล็กรูปพรรณ 1:150 — โครงถักเหล็ก T1-T8, หลังคาทรงปั้นหยา (this file)
warnings: Structural roof-framing plan (steel trusses on the RC roof beams of S-06) -> roof_frame_plan, not roof_plan (op04 extracts it).

Hip roof: common trusses T1 at ~1.33 m (three per 4.00 bay) between the two hip apexes, girder trusses T2 on grids 2 and 18, hip trusses T3 on the four hip lines, and jack trusses T4-T8 in the two hip ends. Only the grid chain (2.00 + 18 x 4.00 + 2.00) and the y chain (2.05 / 2.50 / 5.50 / 2.50 / 2.05) are printed; no truss spacing is printed.

Decision (att1235): T2 (on grid lines) is atomic, eave to eave. T1 and T3-T8 are recorded as one grouped entry per mark with a count read off the plan, because their positions are not dimensioned and would need ~35 scaled-only dummy lines to place one by one. Risk accepted: those members cannot be positioned individually from this file; counts were checked against the mirror-image right end (same counts each end).
Truss member sections are on S-18 (T1/T2, all members C-100x50x20x2.3mm); T3-T8 details are presumably on S-19, not read in this run.
